hero.title:
Hiring software that

feels obvious.
hero.lede: Vellum is an AI-first applicant tracking system for teams who want a beautiful pipeline, calm collaboration, and a candidate experience that doesn't feel like a form.
hero.docker: docker compose up and you have a working ATS at localhost:3000.

features.title: Everything a hiring team needs. <muted>Nothing it doesn't.</muted>
features.lede: One workspace for jobs, candidates, conversations, and decisions — built for small teams that ship and large teams that care about craft.

kanban.title: Kanban pipeline
kanban.body: Drag candidates through stages, with WIP limits, sub-pipelines per role, and history baked in.

ai.title: AI evaluation
ai.body: Summaries, fit scores, and interview recaps. Always labeled, always reviewable, never auto-deciding.

careers.title: Branded career sites
careers.body: SEO-ready job listings on your domain with CNAME, JSON-LD, and a no-code editor.

inbox.title: Unified inbox
inbox.body: Email, scheduling, and team comments in one thread. Context follows the candidate.

calendar.title: Calendar sync
calendar.body: Two-way sync with Google, Microsoft, and CalDAV. Availability, holds, and conflict checks.

privacy.title: Built for privacy
privacy.body: Row-level workspace isolation, PII redaction before AI calls, full audit log, GDPR-ready exports.

ai.title: Helpful in the loop. <hl>Never out of it.</hl>
ai.lede: Vellum drafts, summarizes, and suggests — humans accept, edit, or ignore. No auto-rejects, no silent decisions, no hidden prompts.

points.provider: Choose your provider — Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, or local Ollama.
points.redaction: PII redaction before content leaves your workspace.
points.budgets: Per-feature token budgets and usage reporting.
points.caching: Response caching keyed by workspace + model + prompt.
points.labeled: Every AI-generated surface is clearly labeled.

card.title: Interview recap
card.body: Strong systems instinct — walked through the migration plan with clear failure modes. Pushed back politely on a leading question, which is a good sign. Slightly nervous in the first 10 minutes, settled in once we moved to code.

self.title: Your data, <hl>your servers.</hl>
self.lede: Vellum is open source under AGPL. Run it on a $5 VPS, your enterprise k8s cluster, or anything in between. Bring your own SSO, your own AI keys, your own retention policy.

cta.title: Run your first interview <hl>this afternoon.</hl>
cta.lede: Spin up a workspace, import a job, and invite your team. No credit card, no demo call.
